meta.themes: Agent Infrastructure, Enterprise AI, Provenance, AI Governance

news.title: OpenAI model disproved a central discrete geometry conjecture
news.summary: OpenAI said an internal general-purpose reasoning model found a proof that disproves a longstanding unit-distance conjecture, with external mathematicians checking the result and publishing companion remarks.

news.title: OpenAI added C2PA conformance and SynthID to strengthen provenance
news.summary: OpenAI announced C2PA conformance, Google SynthID watermarking for generated images, and a public verification preview for checking whether images came from OpenAI systems.

news.title: Anthropic acquired Stainless to deepen SDK and MCP tooling
news.summary: Anthropic acquired Stainless, the SDK, CLI, and MCP server tooling company that has generated Anthropic SDKs and helps developers connect agents to APIs and tools.

news.title: KPMG will roll Claude across 276,000 employees and client workflows
news.summary: Anthropic and KPMG announced a global alliance that embeds Claude in KPMG Digital Gateway for tax, legal, private-equity, and cybersecurity work while giving Claude access to KPMG's 276,000-plus employees.

news.title: Google I/O shifted Gemini development toward managed agents and WebMCP
news.summary: Google's developer keynote introduced Gemini 3.5 models, Antigravity 2.0, Managed Agents in the Gemini API, WebMCP, Chrome DevTools for agents, and Android skills for agent-driven app work.

news.title: Google introduced Agent Executor for durable distributed agents
news.summary: Google Cloud previewed Agent Executor, an open-source runtime standard for long-running agent execution, resumption, isolation, connection recovery, and distributed deployment.

news.title: GitHub added one-click Copilot fixes for failing Actions jobs
news.summary: GitHub said Copilot Business and Enterprise users can ask Copilot cloud agent to investigate failed Actions jobs, push a branch fix, and tag the user for review from workflow logs.

news.title: Copilot cloud agent added lower-cost model choices for simple tasks
news.summary: GitHub expanded Copilot cloud agent model options with Claude Haiku 4.5 and GPT-5.4-mini at a 0.33x multiplier for faster, lower-cost handling of straightforward delegated work.

news.title: EY and Microsoft committed $1B to scale enterprise AI execution
news.summary: EY and Microsoft announced a five-year, $1 billion-plus initiative combining Microsoft forward deployed engineers with EY practitioners to move enterprise AI from pilots into governed production workflows.

news.title: Anthropic's xAI compute deal priced frontier capacity at $1.25B per month
news.summary: TechCrunch reported that Anthropic will pay xAI $1.25 billion per month through May 2029 for the full output of the Colossus 1 data center near Memphis.

news.title: Anthropic and Microsoft discussed Maia 200 AI chip capacity
news.summary: CNBC reported that Microsoft is in talks to supply Anthropic with Maia 200 chips, a potential custom-silicon win as Anthropic diversifies beyond Nvidia, AWS Trainium, and Google TPUs.

news.title: White House AI model security order collapsed before signing
news.summary: The Straits Times reported that President Trump pulled a planned executive order for voluntary pre-release access to powerful AI models, leaving no formal U.S. plan for frontier-model security oversight.
